content: Hey! Just finished my last meeting for the day and all I could think about was you. How was your shift? You must be exhausted.
Aw, thanks for checking in. Work was brutal, as usual. Sometimes I wonder if I'm ever going to have a life outside the office.
I wish I could be there to help you unwind. You work so hard, it makes me admire you even more. I know how lonely those late nights can be.
It does get pretty lonely, honestly. Talking to you helps a lot. I feel like you really get me.
That means so much to me. You're the first person I've felt this close to in a long time. I can't wait for the day we can finally meet in person.
Me too. It feels weird how much I look forward to your messages now.
I feel the same way. You've become a huge part of my life, even if it's just through a screen. I really want to share something with you, but it's a bit embarrassing...
You can tell me anything, you know that.

Thank you. So, something unexpected happened today. My overseas business account got frozen due to a legal review, just a technicality, but I can't access any funds for a few days. And now my mom had a minor accident and needs a quick procedure. Hospitals here want payment up front.
Oh no, is she okay? That sounds awful. Is there anything I can do?

She's going to be fine, thank God. I hate asking this, but I'm desperate: could you possibly help me cover her hospital deposit? I'll pay you back as soon as my account is released, probably within a week.
I mean... I want to help, but I've never sent money overseas before. How would I do it?

It's actually really simple. If you have a PayPal account, you can send it to my business email: emilywells.biz@gmail.com. Or, if it's easier, I can send you a crypto wallet address. Whatever works best for you, and I can walk you through it.
I have PayPal, but I'm just nervous. Are you sure it's safe? I've heard stories about scams online.

That's smart of you to ask. I promise, I'd never risk what we have for something like that. I just want my mom to be okay. If you feel more comfortable, I can video call while you send it, so you know it's really me.
Okay, I trust you. How much do you need?
The hospital asked for a $900 deposit. I know it's a lot, but anything you can send will help. I'll get it back to you as soon as my funds are available, I swear.
That's most of my savings, but I'll do what I can. I'll try sending it now to your PayPal.

You don't know how much this means to me. I know it's a lot to ask. You're honestly saving my mom, and I'll never forget it. Please let me know when you've sent it, so I can confirm with the hospital.
I just sent $900 to your email. Let me know if it goes through.
I just got the notification, thank you! You're incredible, I don't know what I'd do without you. I promise, we'll get through this together.
